sourceText: 写一个执行markdown文档：为 CLI 关键词、多模型补充、本地搜索和可审计候选文档读取制定执行方案。
normalizedOutcome: A canonical Markdown execution plan exists for hybrid deterministic and multi-host keyword routing, local bounded search, auditable candidateSpecSet selection, escalation, quality gates, and rollout.
acceptanceClaim: The new decision document gives implementation teams complete schemas, ownership, milestones, tests, budgets, escalation rules, and honest delivery-state boundaries.
